description: This file defines the MatchesBinary class in Twig, which implements a binary expression node representing a regular expression match operation within Twig templates. The class handles validation of the regex pattern, and compiles to a core function call for execution.

classes.name: MatchesBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary expression node for regex matching in Twig templates, handling regex validation, code compilation, and operator representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MatchesBinary node, validates the regex if the right node is a constant, and sets up error handling for invalid regex patterns.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code that performs a regex match using the CoreExtension::matches method.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator string; in this case, an empty string as it is handled via the compile method.
